name: Masked Evaluation (Depth-based Visibility Mask Generation)
aliases: Invisible Region Detection via Depth Warping
definition: Identifies pixels in a reference view that are occluded (invisible) when viewed from a new camera pose by comparing the reference depth map with the depth map warped from the new view.
summary: Masked Evaluation identifies occluded pixels by comparing warped depth maps to generate visibility masks, distinguishing itself by operating directly on rendered depth rather than features.
